jobs.title: Aerospace Security: Vehicle Patrol Driver
jobs.description:
Allied Universal, North America’s leading security and facility services company, is seeking a Security Officer Vehicle Patrol Driver in McKinney, TX. In this role you will conduct routine vehicle and foot patrols, maintain a visible presence, observe and report concerns, and provide exceptional customer service.

The position is full-time with a pay rate of $19.17 per hour. Requirements include at least 2 years of security experience, an active DoD Secret clearance, and a valid driver’s license.

jobs.title: SAP Security Officer (DoD) - Onsite, Active Secret Clearance
jobs.description: RTX is seeking an experienced Alternate Contractor SAP Security Officer (ACSSO) in McKinney, TX to support SAP programs, enforce DoD/IC security requirements, and oversee program-specific documentation and inspections. The candidate will manage personnel records, security flow-down, and contractor oversight while traveling 10–15% as needed.
